key_facts: Third quarter sales were $122.4 million, up 8% compared to the third quarter of 2020 and down 6% sequentially from the second quarter.
Customer demand remains robust, while supply challenges persist, especially for transportation products.
Third quarter gross margin was 37.3%, up 490 basis points from 32.4% in the third quarter of 2020 and up 50 basis points sequentially from the second quarter of 2021.
Third quarter EBITDA margin was 21.7%, up 270 basis points from 19% in the third quarter of 2020.
Third quarter adjusted earnings per share were $0.46, up 35% from $0.34 in the third quarter of 2020.
Operating cash flow for the third quarter was $21 million, down from $26 million in the third quarter of 2020.
New business awards for the third quarter were $179 million, up from $127 million in the same period last year.
Non-transportation related revenue accounted for nearly 50% of total revenue in the third quarter, up from historically around 1/3 of sales.
Sales to transportation customers declined by 5% compared to the third quarter of 2020 and 13% sequentially.
Sales to other end markets increased 24% year-over-year and 3% sequentially.
The company expects an improving trend in 2022 despite ongoing supply chain challenges.
The semiconductor shortage is expected to reduce vehicle builds by nine million to 10 million units this year.
The U.S. light vehicle transportation market SAAR dropped closer to $12 million in September, with an expected range of 13 to 13.5 million units for the year.
On-hand days supply are now closer to 20 days, the lowest in recent history, down over 60% from the five-year average of 55 days.
The company reported a loss of $1.97 per share for the third quarter of 2021.
Adjusted earnings for the third quarter were $0.46 per diluted share compared to $0.34 per diluted share in the same period last year.
The company recorded a noncash charge of $106 million before tax as part of the U.S. pension plan termination process.
The third quarter tax rate was 28.9% due to the impact of the final pension settlement charge.
The company anticipates a 2021 tax rate in the range of 19% to 21%, excluding the impact of the pension settlement and other discrete items.
The company's cash balance was $129 million as of September 30, 2021, up from $92 million on December 31, 2020.
Long-term debt balance was $50 million at the end of the third quarter, down from $55 million on December 31, 2020.
Debt to capitalization ratio was 9.9% at the end of the third quarter, compared to 11.4% at the end of 2020.
The company is near the end of its SAP system rollout, with most sites now running on SAP and completion expected in early 2022.
The company updated its full year 2021 guidance to sales between $495 million and $505 million, and adjusted earnings between $1.85 and $1.95 per share.
The company repurchased approximately 148,000 shares for slightly less than $5 million as part of its stock buyback program.
